messages:
Priya Patel: Hi all, first day! Got a Dell XPS 15 from deliveries but it booted to a BitLocker recovery screen asking for a 48-digit key. Device says "Managed by Redwood Inference (Intune)" at the bottom. I don't have the key. Any guidance?

Jorge (IT): Welcome Priya! :wave: Sorry about that. Can you take a photo of the recovery screen and DM it to me? Also what's the serial from the service tag on the bottom?

Priya Patel: Photo sent to DM. Service tag is 5HB1K72. Recovery screen shows: "Enter the BitLocker recovery key to get to the operating system. Recovery key ID: 2A3B-..."

Maya - Endpoint Admin: Thanks. Looks like this device was reimaged at our staging lab but BitLocker protector wasn't backed up to Intune before shipping. We'll pull the escrowed key first. Priya, don't enter any random keys.

intune-bot: Intune lookup: device(Serial=5HB1K72) -> registered by staging-lab-09 on 2026-07-28T14:10:02Z. BitLocker escrow: NOT FOUND. Enrollment status: Compliant=false.

Jorge (IT): If there's no escrowed key we have two paths: 1) Use the staging admin account to unlock (we can do a remote unlock if you can boot to WinRE and connect to network), or 2) reimage the drive. Reimage will destroy local data but it's a new device so that's ok. Which do you prefer?

Priya Patel: I don't have any local data, reimage is fine if it's faster. I'd prefer getting dev tools installed quickly too (WSL, Chocolatey, Docker).

Maya - Endpoint Admin: We'll reimage but first I'll push a policy to ensure BitLocker protector backup post-enroll so future devices don't hit this. Also I'll create a temporary local admin for you for 3 hours so you can install WSL and Docker after the image is finished.

Jorge (IT): Kicking off reimage job now. Should boot to Windows Autopilot provisioning after wipe. Priya, keep the laptop plugged in and connected to Ethernet or tethered to phone hotspot during OOBE.

intune-bot: Autopilot task 'reimage-1784009123' started by Jorge at 2026-08-01T08:05:15Z. Estimated time 18-22 minutes.

Priya Patel: Machine rebooted into OOBE, I see company logo and "Preparing your device". It asked to sign in with work account, I used priya@redwood.ai and got a prompt for Windows Hello but it failed with "We couldn't set up Windows Hello". Is that expected during autopilot?

Maya - Endpoint Admin: Windows Hello sometimes fails during autopilot if TPM ownership not set or provisioning policy runs after user login. Ignore it for now, you can set it up later. Did it complete Autopilot and land on desktop?

Priya Patel: Yes desktop now. I ran `manage-bde -status` in elevated PowerShell and it shows BitLocker: On, Protection: On. Protector ID list includes TPM and Numerical Password. `manage-bde -protectors -get C:` returns a protector with ID matching the earlier recovery key ID but the key is not displayed.

Priya Patel: Also, software center shows "Company Portal - waiting for device compliance" and some policies still pending.

Maya - Endpoint Admin: Good sign. I'll force a sync and back up the BitLocker key to Intune now. Priya, run `dsregcmd /status` and paste the DeviceId portion. Also run `whoami` to confirm your UPN.

Priya Patel: `dsregcmd /status` -> DeviceId: 9f4a2b3c-...

Priya Patel: `whoami` -> REDWOOD\\priya.patel

Maya - Endpoint Admin: Perfect. Backed up BitLocker key to Intune and associated it with your AAD device id. Jorge, can you confirm retrieval?

Jorge (IT): Retrieved recovery key via Intune console. I've emailed the recovery key to priya@redwood.ai and also uploaded to the internal ticket. Priya, please verify you received it, then discard the email after confirming.

Priya Patel: Got the email with the 48-digit key. I didn't need it after reimage but good to have. Thanks!

Maya - Endpoint Admin: Granting temporary local admin to Priya for 3 hours via Intune LAPS policy. Will expire automatically. Run the usual setup commands: `winget install --id=Microsoft.VisualStudioCode`, `wsl --install`, `choco install docker-desktop -y` (you'll need admin for choco).

intune-bot: Temporary admin role 'temp-admin-3h' assigned to REDWOOD\\priya.patel by Maya at 2026-08-01T08:28:40Z. Expires at 2026-08-01T11:28:40Z.

Priya Patel: Installing VSCode and WSL now. Quick Q: Do we have a preferred distro?

Jorge (IT): Ubuntu-22.04 is the standard. After WSL install, run `wsl --set-default-version 2` and then `wsl --install -d Ubuntu-22.04`. If you run into Docker issues, let us know before changing any firewall rules.

Priya Patel: All installs completed, Docker and WSL okay. Ran `manage-bde -protectors -get C:` again and now Intune shows the key ID and that it's escrowed. Looks like everything is green in Company Portal.

Maya - Endpoint Admin: Great. We'll monitor the device for a couple hours and then revoke the temp admin early if everything looks stable. Welcome aboard, Priya! :tada:

Priya Patel: Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick help. I'll DM Jorge if anything weird pops up.
